_comment: This is YOUR profile — the one the fork ships with so nothing is blank.
1. Rename this file to your username, e.g. profile-data/rahul.json
(username rules: 3-32 chars, letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore)
2. Change "username" below to match the filename exactly — the URL is
derived from it, so they have to agree.
3. Edit the links, then run: npm run build
4. Your permanent URL is /c/<username>/ — the index page shows it, with a
copy button and the QR. You never have to type it.
Delete "_starter" when you are done; that flag is only how the site knows
to show you setup help instead of pretending this is a finished card.
Everything else here is documented in docs/CUSTOMIZATION.md.
tagline: One line people remember you by
